settings.defaultAgentHint: Pre-selected for new chats. You can still pick another agent when creating a chat.
settings.diagnosticsDesc: Collect reports on errors or broken chat UI, and browse saved dumps.
settings.builtinDesc: Agent that runs inside the server — no CLI to install. Add one or more OpenAI-compatible endpoints and tick the models the agent may use.
settings.builtinHint: Works out of the box: reads and edits files in the chat folder, runs commands and asks for permission like any other harness.
settings.builtinProvidersHint: Each provider is one OpenAI-compatible endpoint with its own API key and model list; the agent offers the models of every provider in its picker.
settings.builtinProvidersEmpty: No providers yet — add one so the agent has an endpoint to talk to.
settings.builtinProviderNameHint: Shown in the model picker next to this provider's models.
settings.builtinUrlHint: Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible API, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1 or http://localhost:11434/v1. Empty switches this provider off.
settings.builtinKeyHint: Sent as a Bearer token. Leave empty for local endpoints that need no key.
settings.builtinHeadersHint: Sent with every agent request to this provider. {{sessionId}} in a value is replaced with the chat's session id; rows carrying it are skipped for the model-list probe.
settings.builtinModelsHint: Models come from the endpoint's /models list. Tick the ones the agent may use, rename them or set their context window; add whatever is missing by hand.
settings.builtinModelsConfiguredEmpty: No models configured yet — switch to the full list to tick one, or add one by hand.
settings.builtinModelsEmpty: No models yet — refresh the list or add one by hand.
settings.builtinModelsNoneEnabled: No model is enabled — the built-in agent will have nothing to offer.
settings.agentConnectDesc: Agents are checked automatically when the app starts
settings.agentEnabledHint: Disabled agents are not checked and stay hidden across the interface — no agent pickers, model settings or CLI launch rows.
settings.agentAdvancedDesc: Default folder, API keys and CLI launch
settings.voiceDesc: Choose which voice reads messages aloud.
settings.ttsVoiceGenderHint: Voice used to read messages aloud (browser speech synthesis).
settings.ttsNaturalHint: For the most natural sound, install Windows Natural voices: Settings → Time & Language → Speech (Irina, Pavel Natural and more). Free and fully local.
settings.ttsTestText: This is a voice test. Have a nice day!
settings.mcpApplyHint: Changes apply to new chats. Active chats restart their agent with the new MCP list — history and model are preserved.
settings.mcpFolderFilesHint: MCP files read from each chat's own folder, one path per line, relative to that folder (default: .omp/mcp.json, .cursor/mcp.json, .agents/mcp.json). Servers found there attach to the chats in that folder; clear the list to ignore folder files. A name already used by a server above keeps its configuration.
settings.mcpHint: Attach external tools via the Model Context Protocol. Local — same-network HTTP; Remote — external HTTP with optional token; Stdio — command the agent spawns.
settings.mcpEmptyHint: Attach external tools via the Model Context Protocol. Local — same-network HTTP; Remote — external HTTP with optional token; Stdio — command the agent spawns.
settings.mcpCommandHint: The agent spawns this binary directly — no shell, so a bare name like "npx" is resolved against its PATH. Prefer the full path (e.g. C:/Program Files/nodejs/npx.cmd or /usr/local/bin/mcp-server).
settings.customAgentsHint: Your own ACP agent: point to an executable and its arguments for an agent that speaks the Agent Client Protocol. It joins the list above and behaves like a built-in harness.
settings.customAgentsEmptyHint: Add the executable of any ACP-speaking agent.
settings.customAgentBinaryDirs: Extra %LOCALAPPDATA% folders to search for the command
settings.customAgentParams: Model params as separate config options
settings.customAgentParamsHint: Enable when the agent exposes fast/effort/thought as separate config options.
settings.customAgentInvalid: Missing required fields: name, a free identifier and the executable path.
settings.exportDirHint: Chat exports are saved here. Empty → default: {{path}}
settings.resumeAgentContextHint: On restart (model/MCP change, server restart) the agent continues its previous session instead of starting blank.
settings.resetAgentsHint: Restart all live agent processes without reloading the server.

settings.sidebarCollapseHint: What happens to the tree when it collapses: hide it completely, or keep a narrow icon rail (chats and folders, boards, new chat, recent chats, search).
settings.remoteAccessDesc: Open Acpio from your phone when it shares a VPN or LAN with the PC.
settings.remoteStep1Body: In the project folder run `npm run dev`. The web UI listens on all interfaces (port 18751), the API on 18741. Leave this terminal running.
settings.remoteStep2Title: Connect the phone to the same VPN
settings.remoteStep2Body: Use the same VPN profile as the PC (WireGuard, Tailscale, corporate VPN, etc.). The phone must reach the PC’s VPN or LAN IP — not only the public internet.
settings.remoteStep2HowIp: On the PC: Windows → `ipconfig` (look for the VPN/Ethernet/Wi‑Fi IPv4). On Tailscale — the 100.x address. That IP is what you type on the phone.
settings.remoteStep3Title: Open the UI on the phone
settings.remoteStep3Body: In the phone browser open `http://PC_IP:18751`. Example: `http://192.168.100.209:18751`. Do not use `http://0.0.0.0:18751` — that is only a listen address. `localhost` works only on the PC itself.
settings.remoteStep4Body: A key is generated automatically. A phone or another PC on the same VPN/LAN will ask for it once (the browser remembers it). The PC itself (localhost) never asks. Remove it only with Delete if you want the network open.
settings.remoteKeyHint: Protects the UI on the LAN or from a phone. Generated by default. After editing, click Save. Delete turns the extra lock off.
settings.remoteUnlockLead: This server is protected by a key. Enter the same one as in Settings → Phone & VPN on the PC.
settings.remoteTipLocalhost: From the phone always use the PC IP, never localhost.
settings.remoteTipFirewall: Allow inbound TCP 18751 (and 18741 if needed) in Windows Firewall for private/VPN networks.
settings.remoteTipInstall: After the site opens, tap Install in the toolbar (on iPhone — follow the Safari Add to Home Screen steps).
settings.remoteTipSameNetwork: Phone and PC must be on the same VPN/LAN. Different Wi‑Fi without VPN usually will not work.
settings.remoteTipHttp: Dev mode uses HTTP. On some phones Safari may warn about insecure sites — confirm to continue for a local/VPN address.
settings.remoteTipKey: The key is asked away from localhost. Copy it from Settings on the PC. Delete in settings is the only way to turn the extra lock off.

settings.chatTreeShowArchiveHint: Show archived chats as a separate section in the tree.

settings.chatIntro: This is an interactive chat mock. Click any element to toggle it: active elements are tinted with the theme accent, disabled ones are semi-transparent. Drag the icons under the messages to reorder them. Layout options live in “Advanced”; behavior options are listed below.
settings.builtinSkillPathsHint: Folders the agent scans for skills — a skill is a subfolder with a SKILL.md — one path per line. Relative paths resolve against each chat's folder; `~` is the server user's home (e.g. ~/.agents/skills); absolute paths are global too. Clear the list to turn skills off. A `/name` message invokes a skill.
